final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control A1.2 word for word. That answer is valid until 2027-11-18. It only covers production databases. If the customer is asking about backups of other systems, no approved source covered them.

answer:e30e174f-eb7f-4aa6-aa69-d925e6c90: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:cf60a33f-919c-4bd3-8137-63d56b161: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:a735e53d-914b-4f84-bbc8-3b0db0e0e: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:3965b306-70dd-44d4-bd4d-aa73b5174: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:2c761b46-4e0c-47ed-b30a-60afbd5d4: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
